statement: The run is the stated flow: air at 20 m/s along +x past the body group, with a Reynolds number in the turbulent range and a Mach number far below 0.3

mechanism.how: aero.reference reads the case's inlet against aero_u_inf_m_s and finds the body group; aero.regime computes Re and Mach from the case's viscosity and the model's speed, length and speed of sound
